TEXT / DATA STUDIO

Make your data easier to read.

Validate and format JSON, preview CSV tables and convert between flat JSON and CSV.

JSON, with a little more order

5 MB UTF-8 JSON. JSON → CSV accepts an array of flat objects; nested values need another representation.

A clearer view of CSV

10 MB · 50,000 data rows · 200 columns. First row must have unique non-empty names. UTF-8/BOM supported. Values stay strings, including leading zeros. Downloads escape spreadsheet formulas.

Table preview

Local text processing. Inputs are not saved or uploaded.
